# Gentle King

> Gentle King (gentleking.org) is a free ministry site, confessionally Reformed and Presbyterian. It sets out the gospel of Jesus Christ, Scripture for grief and other hard hours, help for the fight against sin, Reformed doctrine held to the Westminster Confession of Faith, answers to objections against Christianity, and Sojourner, a free offline Bible study app for Windows.

The site is written by Colt, a layman in the Reformed Presbyterian tradition. He is not a pastor or an elder, and the site is no substitute for a local church. Scripture is quoted from the King James Version. The Westminster Standards are quoted from the text of 1647. The writing may be copied and shared freely under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 license. Please do not sell it, and please do not change the words and keep the name on it.

Sojourner 0.4.0 is free Bible study software for Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit, made by the same writer and given away free. It needs no account, works with the network off, and sends no telemetry. The installer is about 592 MB.

Mortify (https://mortify.gentleking.org/) is a free web app by the same writer for putting sin to death by the Spirit. It works in the browser on a phone or a computer, and it needs a free account made with an email address.

Anyone in danger or thinking of ending their life can call 911, or call or text 988, in the United States. Anyone being hurt at home can call the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-7233, or text START to 88788. If a child is being hurt, call 911. Outside the United States, call the local emergency number. The page If You Are Not Safe (https://gentleking.org/comfort-safety.html) gives these numbers and more.

## The gospel

- [The Gospel of Jesus Christ](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html): What is the gospel? Who God is, what sin has done, how Christ died and rose for sinners, and how you are forgiven and made right with God by faith alone. Its parts are [Who God Is](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#god), [What Sin Is and What It Has Done](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#sin), [The Wrath of God and the Judgment to Come](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#wrath), [Jesus Christ, the Gentle King](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#christ), [Grace Alone](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#grace), [Repentance and Faith](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#repentance), [Justification by Faith Alone](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#justification), [The Life That Comes After](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#new-life), and [Come to Him](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#come).

## Comfort in hard hours

- [Scripture for the Hard Hour](https://gentleking.org/comfort.html): King James Bible verses and plain counsel for grief, the death of a spouse or child, suicide loss, illness, divorce, a prodigal child, depression, and danger. Its parts are [What Has Happened](https://gentleking.org/comfort.html#what-happened), [He Knows This Sorrow](https://gentleking.org/comfort.html#christ-knows), [When You Cannot Pray](https://gentleking.org/comfort.html#cannot-pray), [Do Not Carry It Alone](https://gentleking.org/comfort.html#not-alone), and [Believest Thou This](https://gentleking.org/comfort.html#come).
- [When Someone You Love Has Died](https://gentleking.org/comfort-grief.html): Scripture and plain counsel for the night someone you love has died. Christ wept at a grave, and he will not hurry you past your grief. Its one part is [When you are ready to search your heart](https://gentleking.org/comfort-grief.html#grief-search).
- [When Your Husband or Wife Has Died](https://gentleking.org/comfort-widowed.html): King James Scripture and plain counsel for a widow or widower. The one who saw to his mother from the cross still sees the one left behind. Its parts are [When you are ready to ask about heaven](https://gentleking.org/comfort-widowed.html#widowed-heaven) and [When you are ready to search your heart](https://gentleking.org/comfort-widowed.html#widowed-search).
- [When Your Child Has Died](https://gentleking.org/comfort-death-of-a-child.html): Scripture for parents who have lost a child, before birth, as a baby, or grown. Christ took little children in his arms, and he holds the keys of death. Its parts are [If you lost a baby or a little child](https://gentleking.org/comfort-death-of-a-child.html#baby), [If your baby died before birth](https://gentleking.org/comfort-death-of-a-child.html#before-birth), [If your son or daughter was older](https://gentleking.org/comfort-death-of-a-child.html#older-child), [For every grieving parent](https://gentleking.org/comfort-death-of-a-child.html#every-parent), and [When you are ready to search your heart](https://gentleking.org/comfort-death-of-a-child.html#child-search).
- [When You Fear They Did Not Know Christ](https://gentleking.org/comfort-did-they-know-christ.html): Grieving someone who may not have known Christ? Leave them with the Judge of all the earth, who will do right, and bring your own soul to him. Its one part is [When you are ready to search your heart](https://gentleking.org/comfort-did-they-know-christ.html#unsure-search).
- [When Someone You Love Took Their Own Life](https://gentleking.org/comfort-suicide-loss.html): For those left behind after a suicide. Scripture on grief, false guilt, and the keeping of Christ. If you are in danger, call or text 988 now. Its one part is [When you are ready to search your heart](https://gentleking.org/comfort-suicide-loss.html#suicide-loss-search).
- [When Serious Illness Comes](https://gentleking.org/comfort-illness.html): King James Scripture for a hard diagnosis, a long illness, caring for someone, and the end of life. Your times are in the hand of God. Its parts are [When it has gone on for years](https://gentleking.org/comfort-illness.html#long-illness), [If you are caring for someone](https://gentleking.org/comfort-illness.html#caregiver), [If death is near](https://gentleking.org/comfort-illness.html#dying), and [When you are ready to search your heart](https://gentleking.org/comfort-illness.html#illness-search).
- [When Your Marriage Is Breaking](https://gentleking.org/comfort-marriage.html): Scripture for the betrayed and the deserted, what God has said about divorce, a word for the one who broke faith, and a word for children of divorce. Its parts are [What God has said about divorce](https://gentleking.org/comfort-marriage.html#divorce), [When you are ready to search your heart](https://gentleking.org/comfort-marriage.html#marriage-search), [If you are the one who broke faith](https://gentleking.org/comfort-marriage.html#if-it-was-me), and [If it is your parents](https://gentleking.org/comfort-marriage.html#parents).
- [When Your Child Walks Away From the Lord](https://gentleking.org/comfort-prodigal.html): For parents of a prodigal. Only God gives a new heart, and he has done it for sons and daughters as far off as yours. Pray, wait, and keep the door open. Its one part is [When you are ready to search your heart](https://gentleking.org/comfort-prodigal.html#prodigal-search).
- [When the Work or the Home Is Gone](https://gentleking.org/comfort-work-and-home.html): For a lost job, a failed business, or a house taken by fire or flood. Your Father knows what you need, and his church is bound to help. Its one part is [When you are ready to search your heart](https://gentleking.org/comfort-work-and-home.html#want-search).
- [When You Are Alone](https://gentleking.org/comfort-loneliness.html): For the single, the divorced, the newly moved, and the lonely in a crowded church. Christ was left alone, and God setteth the solitary in families. Its parts are [God Setteth the Solitary in Families](https://gentleking.org/comfort-loneliness.html#families), [If You Are Single](https://gentleking.org/comfort-loneliness.html#single), [If You Are Married and Alone](https://gentleking.org/comfort-loneliness.html#married-and-alone), and [When you are ready to search your heart](https://gentleking.org/comfort-loneliness.html#loneliness-search).
- [When Your Own Mind Has Gone Dark](https://gentleking.org/comfort-depression.html): For the Christian under depression. Christ was very heavy in Gethsemane, and he will not break a bruised reed. Scripture, care for the body, and help. Its one part is [When you are ready to search your heart](https://gentleking.org/comfort-depression.html#darkness-search).
- [If You Are Not Safe](https://gentleking.org/comfort-safety.html): In danger now? Call 911. Thinking of ending your life? Call or text 988. Being hurt at home? Call 1-800-799-7233. Leaving to be safe is not a sin. Its parts are [If you are thinking of ending your life](https://gentleking.org/comfort-safety.html#ending-your-life), [If someone is hurting you](https://gentleking.org/comfort-safety.html#someone-hurting-you), and [If a child is being hurt](https://gentleking.org/comfort-safety.html#child-hurt).

## Fighting sin

- [A Greater Affection](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html): Worn down by the same sin? Scripture, John Owen, and the Westminster Standards on putting sin to death by the Spirit, and on assurance that rests on Christ. Its parts are [If You Are Tired of Losing](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#tired), [The Heart Is Never Empty](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#never-empty), [Beholding Christ](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#beholding), [Where the Fight Begins](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#first), [Putting Sin to Death](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#put-to-death), [How the Fight Is Fought](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#the-fight), [Mortify](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#mortify), [When the Sin Has a Name](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#named), [The Ground Under Your Feet](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#ground), [If You Have Made Peace With It](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#at-peace), and [Until You See Him](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#until).

## Doctrine

- [What the Reformed Have Confessed](https://gentleking.org/doctrine.html): What do Reformed Christians believe? The five solas, the doctrines of grace, covenant theology, and the last things, held to the Westminster Confession. Its parts are [Why Doctrine Is Not the Enemy of Devotion](https://gentleking.org/doctrine.html#why-doctrine), [The Word of God](https://gentleking.org/doctrine.html#scripture), [God, and God as Trinity](https://gentleking.org/doctrine.html#god-and-trinity), [Alone Means Alone](https://gentleking.org/doctrine.html#five-solas), [How God Saves Sinners](https://gentleking.org/doctrine.html#doctrines-of-grace), [One Story, Two Testaments](https://gentleking.org/doctrine.html#covenant), [Two Words From One God](https://gentleking.org/doctrine.html#law-and-gospel), [Where Christ Feeds His People](https://gentleking.org/doctrine.html#church-and-worship), [How It Ends, and What Is Settled](https://gentleking.org/doctrine.html#last-things), and [The Standards, and the Savior in Them](https://gentleking.org/doctrine.html#standards).

## Answers to objections

- [A Reason for the Hope](https://gentleking.org/apologetics.html): Honest answers to common objections to Christianity, from God and the Bible to evil and hell, and Scripture for the believer who fears he is not really saved. Its parts are [Which Part Is Yours](https://gentleking.org/apologetics.html#two-readers), [For the One Who Objects](https://gentleking.org/apologetics.html#objector), and [For the Believer Who Is Afraid](https://gentleking.org/apologetics.html#believer).
- [Is God There](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-god.html): Is there no evidence for God? Who made God? Has science replaced him? Every argument against God is made with tools that only work if he is there. Its parts are [There is no evidence for God](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-god.html#no-evidence), [Who made God?](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-god.html#who-made-god), [Science has replaced God](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-god.html#science), and [Faith is believing without evidence](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-god.html#faith-and-evidence).
- [Can the Bible Be Trusted](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-bible.html): Men wrote it, men chose the books, it contradicts itself, it was changed. Plain answers on the authority of the Bible, its canon, and its manuscripts. Its parts are [Men wrote it](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-bible.html#men-wrote-it), [Men chose which books went in](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-bible.html#the-canon), [It contradicts itself](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-bible.html#contradictions), [It has been changed over time](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-bible.html#changed-over-time), [You are arguing in a circle](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-bible.html#circular), and [Nobody can take it all literally](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-bible.html#literally).
- [Did Jesus Rise](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-resurrection.html): Did Jesus live? Is the resurrection a legend? Did the disciples lie, or were they fooled? The faith rests on an event at a real time and place. Its parts are [He may never have lived](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-resurrection.html#never-lived), [The resurrection is a legend](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-resurrection.html#legend), [The disciples lied, or they were fooled](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-resurrection.html#lied-or-fooled), and [Dead men do not rise](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-resurrection.html#dead-men-do-not-rise).
- [Why Is There Evil](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-evil.html): The problem of evil, whether God is to blame, the conquest of Canaan, and slavery in the Bible, answered with care for those who carry a grief of their own. Its parts are [A good and powerful God would stop it](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-evil.html#why-allow-evil), [Then God is to blame](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-evil.html#is-god-to-blame), [The God of the Old Testament is cruel](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-evil.html#old-testament), and [The Bible approves of slavery](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-evil.html#slavery).
- [Who Decides What Is Good](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-morality.html): Is morality only evolution or culture? Nearly everyone is sure that some things are really wrong. Very few ask what makes them so. Its parts are [I can be good without God](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-morality.html#good-without-god) and [Morality is only evolution or culture](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-morality.html#evolution-or-culture).
- [Is Hell Just](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-hell.html): Would a loving God send anyone to hell? Is forever too long for a short life of sin? Hell is real, and it should never be spoken of lightly or left out. Its parts are [A loving God would not send anyone there](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-hell.html#a-loving-god) and [Forever is too long for a short life of sin](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-hell.html#forever).
- [Why Only Jesus](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-only-jesus.html): Do all religions lead to God? What about those who never heard? Is it arrogant to say you are right? Why Christians say Jesus is the only way. Its parts are [All religions lead to God](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-only-jesus.html#all-religions), [What about those who never heard?](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-only-jesus.html#never-heard), and [It is arrogant to say you are right](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-only-jesus.html#arrogance).
- [What About the Christians](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-christians.html): The church is full of hypocrites, and religion has done great harm. Some of the strongest arguments against Christ come from people who carry his name. Its parts are [The church is full of hypocrites](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-christians.html#hypocrites) and [Religion has done great harm](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-christians.html#harm).
- [Is Election Fair](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-election.html): The Bible teaches that God chooses whom he will save. Is that fair, and is there any point in trying? Paul raised the objection himself. Its parts are [If God chooses, how can he blame me?](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-election.html#how-can-he-blame-me) and [Then there is no point in trying](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-election.html#no-point-trying).
- [The Objection Under the Others](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-the-real-objection.html): Every objection has an answer. Jesus said the reason men stay away from him lies somewhere else. The law, the human heart, and the hope for sinners. Its parts are [I am a good person](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-the-real-objection.html#good-person) and [Then what hope is there for me?](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-the-real-objection.html#what-hope).

## Fear, doubt, and assurance, for believers

- [Am I Really His](https://gentleking.org/assurance-am-i-his.html): Not sure you are saved? Afraid your faith was never real, or that you were not chosen? The Westminster Confession on the grounds of assurance. Its parts are [I do not know if I am saved](https://gentleking.org/assurance-am-i-his.html#not-sure), [Maybe my faith was never real](https://gentleking.org/assurance-am-i-his.html#never-real), and [I am afraid I was not chosen](https://gentleking.org/assurance-am-i-his.html#not-chosen).
- [When Sin Will Not Leave](https://gentleking.org/assurance-remaining-sin.html): The same sin again, a sin too great to forgive, a God surely tired of forgiving. What God has written for the believer who keeps falling. Its parts are [I keep going back to the same sin](https://gentleking.org/assurance-remaining-sin.html#same-sin), [What I did is too great to forgive](https://gentleking.org/assurance-remaining-sin.html#too-great), and [He must be tired of forgiving me](https://gentleking.org/assurance-remaining-sin.html#tired-of-forgiving).
- [Fears That Keep You Awake](https://gentleking.org/assurance-night-fears.html): Afraid you committed the unpardonable sin, frightened by Hebrews 6 and 10, or afraid you could lose your salvation? Answers that will not give way. Its parts are [I think I have committed the unpardonable sin](https://gentleking.org/assurance-night-fears.html#unpardonable-sin), [Hebrews 6 and 10 frighten me](https://gentleking.org/assurance-night-fears.html#hebrews-6-and-10), and [I might lose my salvation](https://gentleking.org/assurance-night-fears.html#losing-salvation).
- [When God Feels Far](https://gentleking.org/assurance-god-feels-far.html): Prayer feels like talking to the ceiling and the Bible is only ink. Scripture for the believer who fears the Lord and still walks in darkness. Its parts are [I feel nothing, and God is silent](https://gentleking.org/assurance-god-feels-far.html#silence) and [The darkness is in my body too](https://gentleking.org/assurance-god-feels-far.html#body).
- [Doubts and Unwanted Thoughts](https://gentleking.org/assurance-doubts-and-thoughts.html): For the believer who wonders if any of it is true, and for one troubled by blasphemous thoughts that will not stop. Lord, I believe, help thou mine unbelief. Its parts are [Sometimes I wonder if any of it is true](https://gentleking.org/assurance-doubts-and-thoughts.html#is-it-true) and [I have thoughts I would never choose](https://gentleking.org/assurance-doubts-and-thoughts.html#unwanted-thoughts).
- [When Life Breaks](https://gentleking.org/assurance-affliction.html): When life breaks, a harder question rises about what God thinks of you. Romans 8, Hebrews 12, and the difference between punishment and chastening. Its parts are [It feels as if God is against me](https://gentleking.org/assurance-affliction.html#god-against-me) and [I think he is punishing me](https://gentleking.org/assurance-affliction.html#punishment).
- [When Death Comes Near](https://gentleking.org/assurance-death.html): Christians still die, and many dread it. Christ took flesh to deliver those who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
- [Safe in His Keeping](https://gentleking.org/assurance-kept.html): Underneath every fear is the suspicion that it all hangs on you. Nothing can separate a believer from the love of God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

## Practical guides

- [Plain Guides for the Christian Life](https://gentleking.org/guides.html): What the Bible says about marriage, sex, abortion, IVF, money, alcohol, gambling, tattoos, government, and death, and practical guides for prayer and church. Its parts are [What These Are](https://gentleking.org/guides.html#about-these), [The Christian Life](https://gentleking.org/guides.html#christian-life), [Discernment and the Church](https://gentleking.org/guides.html#discernment), and [What the Bible Says](https://gentleking.org/guides.html#bible-says).
- [How to Pray](https://gentleking.org/guide-prayer.html): What prayer is, how to pray in the name of Christ, how to use the Lord’s Prayer as a pattern, what displeases God in prayer, and how to make it a habit. Its parts are [What Prayer Is](https://gentleking.org/guide-prayer.html#what-prayer-is), [How to Pray](https://gentleking.org/guide-prayer.html#how), [Use the Lord’s Prayer as the Pattern](https://gentleking.org/guide-prayer.html#lords-prayer), [What Displeases God in Prayer](https://gentleking.org/guide-prayer.html#what-to-avoid), and [Make It a Habit](https://gentleking.org/guide-prayer.html#habits).
- [How to Read the Bible](https://gentleking.org/guide-bible-reading.html): How to read the Bible for yourself with prayer and understanding, where a new reader should start, a plan for the whole Bible, and helps worth having. Its parts are [Why Read It Yourself](https://gentleking.org/guide-bible-reading.html#why), [How to Read It](https://gentleking.org/guide-bible-reading.html#how), [Where to Start](https://gentleking.org/guide-bible-reading.html#where), and [Helps Worth Having](https://gentleking.org/guide-bible-reading.html#helps).
- [How to Meditate on and Memorize Scripture](https://gentleking.org/guide-meditation.html): How to meditate on Scripture the biblical way, not by emptying the mind, with a simple method for one verse and a plan to memorize in small moments. Its parts are [What Meditation Is and Is Not](https://gentleking.org/guide-meditation.html#what-it-is), [The Tree by the Rivers](https://gentleking.org/guide-meditation.html#the-tree), [How to Meditate on a Verse](https://gentleking.org/guide-meditation.html#how), [Why and How to Memorize](https://gentleking.org/guide-meditation.html#memorize), [Use the Small Moments](https://gentleking.org/guide-meditation.html#small-moments), and [This Week](https://gentleking.org/guide-meditation.html#this-week).
- [How to Examine Yourself](https://gentleking.org/guide-examine-yourself.html): How to examine yourself as Scripture commands, with questions from the Larger Catechism, a short daily habit, and a caution for the anxious. Its parts are [Why Examine Yourself](https://gentleking.org/guide-examine-yourself.html#why), [Look at Christ First](https://gentleking.org/guide-examine-yourself.html#first), [Questions to Ask](https://gentleking.org/guide-examine-yourself.html#questions), [How to Do It](https://gentleking.org/guide-examine-yourself.html#how), and [Two Cautions](https://gentleking.org/guide-examine-yourself.html#cautions).
- [How to Repent](https://gentleking.org/guide-repentance.html): How to repent of sin, by the Shorter Catechism. Godly sorrow, confessing sins by name, restitution, and the Father who runs to meet the prodigal. Its parts are [What Repentance Is](https://gentleking.org/guide-repentance.html#what), [Two Kinds of Sorrow](https://gentleking.org/guide-repentance.html#sorrow), [Repent of Sins by Name](https://gentleking.org/guide-repentance.html#by-name), [Coming Home, and Coming Home Again](https://gentleking.org/guide-repentance.html#again), and [Steps for Today](https://gentleking.org/guide-repentance.html#steps).
- [The Ten Commandments for a Believer](https://gentleking.org/guide-ten-commandments.html): Why a Christian keeps the Ten Commandments, how to read them, what each one requires and forbids by the Shorter Catechism, and how to use them. Its parts are [Why a Believer Keeps the Law](https://gentleking.org/guide-ten-commandments.html#why-keep), [How to Read Them](https://gentleking.org/guide-ten-commandments.html#rules), [Each Commandment in Plain Words](https://gentleking.org/guide-ten-commandments.html#each), and [How to Use Them This Week](https://gentleking.org/guide-ten-commandments.html#use).
- [How God Is to Be Worshiped](https://gentleking.org/guide-worship.html): The regulative principle of worship explained plainly. What God commands in worship, elements and circumstances, psalm singing, and why it matters. Its parts are [The Principle](https://gentleking.org/guide-worship.html#principle), [Where Scripture Teaches It](https://gentleking.org/guide-worship.html#scripture), [What God Has Commanded](https://gentleking.org/guide-worship.html#elements), [Elements and Circumstances](https://gentleking.org/guide-worship.html#circumstances), [What It Means in Practice](https://gentleking.org/guide-worship.html#practice), [Why It Matters](https://gentleking.org/guide-worship.html#why), [Common Objections](https://gentleking.org/guide-worship.html#objections), and [What to Do](https://gentleking.org/guide-worship.html#what-to-do).
- [How to Hear a Sermon](https://gentleking.org/guide-hearing-sermons.html): How to listen to a sermon by the Larger Catechism. Preparing, listening with children, the parable of the sower, and doing what you hear. Its parts are [Why Preaching Matters](https://gentleking.org/guide-hearing-sermons.html#why), [What God Asks of a Hearer](https://gentleking.org/guide-hearing-sermons.html#how), [Four Kinds of Hearers](https://gentleking.org/guide-hearing-sermons.html#soils), [Doers, Not Hearers Only](https://gentleking.org/guide-hearing-sermons.html#doers), [When the Sermon Seems Dull](https://gentleking.org/guide-hearing-sermons.html#dull), and [Steps for This Week](https://gentleking.org/guide-hearing-sermons.html#this-week).
- [How to Prepare for the Lord’s Supper](https://gentleking.org/guide-lords-supper.html): How to prepare for communion by the Larger Catechism. Examining yourself, eating unworthily, doubting believers, and what to do at the table. Its parts are [What the Supper Is](https://gentleking.org/guide-lords-supper.html#what-it-is), [Let a Man Examine Himself](https://gentleking.org/guide-lords-supper.html#examine), [If You Doubt Whether You Should Come](https://gentleking.org/guide-lords-supper.html#doubting), [Who Should Not Come](https://gentleking.org/guide-lords-supper.html#who-should-not), and [How to Prepare](https://gentleking.org/guide-lords-supper.html#steps).
- [How to Keep the Lord’s Day](https://gentleking.org/guide-lords-day.html): Why the Lord’s Day is the Christian Sabbath, how to keep it holy, works of necessity and mercy, and how to make it a delight for a family. Its parts are [Why It Matters](https://gentleking.org/guide-lords-day.html#why), [How to Keep It](https://gentleking.org/guide-lords-day.html#how), [Works of Necessity and Mercy](https://gentleking.org/guide-lords-day.html#necessity-and-mercy), and [With Children](https://gentleking.org/guide-lords-day.html#with-children).
- [How to Fast](https://gentleking.org/guide-fasting.html): How to fast biblically. Fasting with prayer, what Isaiah 58 says it is not, how to begin with one meal, and health cautions. Its parts are [When Ye Fast](https://gentleking.org/guide-fasting.html#when), [Fasting Joined to Prayer](https://gentleking.org/guide-fasting.html#prayer), [What Fasting Is Not](https://gentleking.org/guide-fasting.html#not), [How to Fast](https://gentleking.org/guide-fasting.html#how), [When Not to Fast From Food](https://gentleking.org/guide-fasting.html#cautions), and [Your First Fast](https://gentleking.org/guide-fasting.html#first-fast).
- [How to Lead Family Worship](https://gentleking.org/guide-family-worship.html): How to lead family worship in a few minutes a day. Read the Bible, sing a psalm, and pray, with plain counsel for starting and keeping on. Its parts are [Why a Household Worships](https://gentleking.org/guide-family-worship.html#why), [What to Do](https://gentleking.org/guide-family-worship.html#how), and [How to Start and Keep Going](https://gentleking.org/guide-family-worship.html#start).
- [How to Forgive and Seek Forgiveness](https://gentleking.org/guide-forgiveness.html): How to forgive as a Christian and how to ask forgiveness. Matthew 18, restitution, reconciliation, and why forgiving never means staying in danger. Its parts are [Forgiven People Forgive](https://gentleking.org/guide-forgiveness.html#forgiven-forgive), [When You Have Wronged Someone](https://gentleking.org/guide-forgiveness.html#seeking), [When Someone Has Wronged You](https://gentleking.org/guide-forgiveness.html#wronged), [What Forgiveness Is and Is Not](https://gentleking.org/guide-forgiveness.html#is-not), [When They Never Make It Right](https://gentleking.org/guide-forgiveness.html#hard), and [What to Do This Week](https://gentleking.org/guide-forgiveness.html#this-week).
- [How to Share the Gospel](https://gentleking.org/guide-evangelism.html): How an ordinary Christian shares the gospel. Know the message, pray, ask questions, call for repentance and faith, and invite people to church. Its parts are [Why Every Christian Tells Others](https://gentleking.org/guide-evangelism.html#why), [Know the Message](https://gentleking.org/guide-evangelism.html#know), [How to Do It](https://gentleking.org/guide-evangelism.html#how), [When They Object](https://gentleking.org/guide-evangelism.html#objections), and [What to Avoid](https://gentleking.org/guide-evangelism.html#cautions).
- [How to Read the Bible Rightly](https://gentleking.org/guide-reading-scripture.html): How to tell what in the Bible is literal and what is figurative. Kinds of biblical writing, Scripture interpreting Scripture, and Christ at the center. Its parts are [All of It Is True](https://gentleking.org/guide-reading-scripture.html#all-true), [What Reading Literally Means](https://gentleking.org/guide-reading-scripture.html#literally), [Know What Kind of Writing It Is](https://gentleking.org/guide-reading-scripture.html#kinds), [How to Tell a Figure of Speech](https://gentleking.org/guide-reading-scripture.html#figures), [Read for Christ, and With the Church](https://gentleking.org/guide-reading-scripture.html#christ), and [Steps for This Week](https://gentleking.org/guide-reading-scripture.html#this-week).
- [How to Read Prophecy and Revelation](https://gentleking.org/guide-prophecy.html): How to read Bible prophecy and Revelation. Amillennialism and postmillennialism set out fairly, premillennialism, and why not to set dates. Its parts are [What Every Reformed Believer Holds](https://gentleking.org/guide-prophecy.html#common), [How Prophecy Works](https://gentleking.org/guide-prophecy.html#prophecy), [How to Read Revelation](https://gentleking.org/guide-prophecy.html#revelation), [The Thousand Years](https://gentleking.org/guide-prophecy.html#millennium), [Do Not Set Dates](https://gentleking.org/guide-prophecy.html#date-setting), and [Watch and Be Ready](https://gentleking.org/guide-prophecy.html#watch).
- [How to Spot a False Teacher](https://gentleking.org/guide-false-teachers.html): How to spot a false teacher. Seven questions to test any preacher by Scripture, common warning signs today, and what to do about it. Its parts are [Christ Warned You](https://gentleking.org/guide-false-teachers.html#warning), [How to Test a Teacher](https://gentleking.org/guide-false-teachers.html#test), [Common Warning Signs Today](https://gentleking.org/guide-false-teachers.html#signs), [Be Careful in Both Directions](https://gentleking.org/guide-false-teachers.html#careful), and [What to Do](https://gentleking.org/guide-false-teachers.html#what-to-do).
- [How to Spot Real Heresy](https://gentleking.org/guide-heresy.html): The difference between heresy, serious error, and disagreement among the faithful, the truths that mark the line, and how to respond. Its parts are [What Heresy Is](https://gentleking.org/guide-heresy.html#what), [The Truths That Mark the Line](https://gentleking.org/guide-heresy.html#test), [Where It Shows Up](https://gentleking.org/guide-heresy.html#examples), and [How to Respond](https://gentleking.org/guide-heresy.html#respond).
- [How to Weigh “God Told Me”](https://gentleking.org/guide-new-revelation.html): Does God still speak today? The sufficiency of Scripture, prophecy and tongues, how God guides believers, and how to test a claimed word. Its parts are [God Has Spoken in His Son](https://gentleking.org/guide-new-revelation.html#enough), [Prophecy, Tongues, and Miracles](https://gentleking.org/guide-new-revelation.html#gifts), [How God Guides You Now](https://gentleking.org/guide-new-revelation.html#guidance), [Test Every Claimed Word](https://gentleking.org/guide-new-revelation.html#testing), [When a Friend Says “God Told Me”](https://gentleking.org/guide-new-revelation.html#friend), and [This Week](https://gentleking.org/guide-new-revelation.html#this-week).
- [How to Test Books, Music, and Preachers Online](https://gentleking.org/guide-media.html): Christian discernment for books, podcasts, music, films, and online preachers. Testing by Scripture, your own elders, and guarding your time. ## Sojourner, a free Bible study app

- [Sojourner](https://gentleking.org/sojourner.html): Sojourner is free, offline Bible study software for Windows. Thirteen translations, the Hebrew and Greek, Matthew Henry, Calvin, and the Westminster Standards. Its parts are [Scripture, and the Church Reading It With You](https://gentleking.org/sojourner.html#what), [The Heart of It](https://gentleking.org/sojourner.html#features), [Offline, and Yours](https://gentleking.org/sojourner.html#offline), [Get Sojourner](https://gentleking.org/sojourner.html#get-it), [Free Bible Software for Windows](https://gentleking.org/sojourner.html#free-bible-software), [What It Does Not Have](https://gentleking.org/sojourner.html#limits), [More About Sojourner](https://gentleking.org/sojourner.html#more), and [Feedback](https://gentleking.org/sojourner.html#feedback).
- [Everything Sojourner Does](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html): Everything Sojourner does, with pictures. Linked panes, Color text, the Hebrew and Greek, the atlas and timeline, search, sermons, and family worship. Its parts are [Panes That Follow Each Other](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#panes), [Color Text](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#color-text), [The Original Words, for People Who Have None](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#languages), [The People and the Ground They Walked](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#maps), [One Search Box](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#search), [Reading](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#reading), [Notes That Stay Yours](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#notes), [Preparing and Preaching](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#sermons), [The Ordinary Days](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#devotion), and [Family Worship](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#family).
- [What Comes in the Box](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-library.html): The Bibles, Hebrew and Greek texts, lexicons, commentaries, Westminster Standards, and book shelves that come with Sojourner, and where each one came from. Its parts are [The Library It Ships With](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-library.html#library), [How Much Is in There](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-library.html#reference), [Four Shelves, and Your Own](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-library.html#shelves), and [Where the Texts Came From](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-library.html#credits).
- [Installing and Updating](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-install.html): How to install Sojourner on Windows, what the SmartScreen warning means, how to update without losing your notes, and how to add the book shelves and map packs. Its parts are [Installing It](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-install.html#install), [Two Honest Warnings](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-install.html#before-you-install), [Updating](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-install.html#updating), [The Book Shelves and the Map Packs](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-install.html#shelves), and [Bug Reports and Corrections](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-install.html#trouble).
- [Download Sojourner](https://github.com/z3r0Colt/sojourner/releases): The Windows installer and the four optional book shelves, on GitHub

## Mortify, a free app for the fight against sin

- [Mortify](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html): Mortify is a free app for putting sin to death by the Spirit. Flee in temptation, a morning reading, an evening examination, and help after a fall. Its parts are [Open Mortify](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#open), [Help to Put Sin to Death by the Spirit](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#what), [In the Hour of Temptation](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#flee), [When You Have Fallen](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#fallen), [Morning and Evening](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#daily), [Fifteen Sins by Name](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#battles), [A Few Brethren From Your Church](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#brethren), [Private by Design](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#private), [What It Will Ask of You](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#begin), [What It Is Not](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#not), and [Write to Me](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#questions).
- [Open Mortify](https://mortify.gentleking.org/): The app itself, in the browser

## About the site

- [About Gentle King](https://gentleking.org/about.html): Gentle King is written by Colt, a layman in the Reformed Presbyterian tradition who also made Sojourner. What is believed here, and how to get in touch. Its parts are [What This Is](https://gentleking.org/about.html#what-this-is), [Who I Am](https://gentleking.org/about.html#who), [What I Believe](https://gentleking.org/about.html#what-i-believe), [How to Get in Touch](https://gentleking.org/about.html#contact), and [A Word to You](https://gentleking.org/about.html#a-word).
